title: Abbas utho tumko sada deta hai hussain
body:
Abbas utho tumko sada deta hai hussain
Haye zakhmo se chur chur the mazloom e Karbala
Khanjar sambhale hath me Shimr laeen badha
Baithi thi apne laal ke nazdeek Sayyeda
Ek baar ayi kanon me mazloom ki sada
Abbas.......x5
Rukh suwe alkama kiya
Karne lagi yeh bain
Abbas utho
Tumko sada deta hain Hussain...x3
Sadmon se tishnagi se dilafgar hain Hussain
Zakhmo se chur chur hain laachar hain Hussain
Teri madad ka aaj talabgar hain Hussain
<<MINI>>
Abbas utho tumko.....x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Sab khoon chuka hain ban me sahare mera Hussain
Noha kuna hain dard ka mara mera Hussain
Karta hain zere lab jo ishare mera Hussain
Tujhko nahi to kisko pukare mera Hussain
<<MINI>>
Abbas utho tumko.....x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Sheh ke gale pe shimr ne rakkhi ju hi churi
Wo dekh khaymagah se Zainab nikalo padi
Aankhe mere Hussain ki ashkon se hhain bhari
Chin jaye na behan ki rida fikr hain badi
<<MINI>>
Abbas utho tumko....x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Tanha sitamgaron ne ise gher liya hain
Jee jaisa jiska chaha sitam usne kiya hain
Teeron se pattharon se ise zakhmi kiya hain
Ab janibe Hussain sitamgaar bandha hain
<<MINI>>
Abbas utho tumko....x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Tere supurd karke gaye the jise Ali
Kya yaad woh wassiyate aakhir nahi rahi
Maqtal hain yeh Hussain ka aur qatl ki ghadi
Sunkar fuga Hussain ki kehne lage Ali
<<MINI>>
Abbas utho tumko....x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Khanjar sambhale hath me hain Shimr badsitar
Karti hain bain maut buka karti hain hayat
Ek din me lut gayi hain mere bacche ki kaynat
Dekhe suwe khayam kabhi Janine furaat
<<MINI>>
Abbas utho tumko....x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Is haal me bhi shukre khuda karte rahe Hussain
Khamosh rehke zulm o sitam sehta hain Hussain
Teri wafa ka tujhko sila deta hain Hussain
Is bekasi me tumko sada deta hain Hussain
<<MINI>>
Abbas utho tumko....x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Farhan o Mazhar Abdi kaisa woh khwab tha
Aashur ka woh roz tha hum aur Karbala
Pohoncha paye ziyarat e Abbas e bawafa
Kanon me aayi ek sisakti hui sada
<<MINI>>
Abbas utho tumko....x2
